test_finetune_bert2bert: test finetuning a BERT-to-BERT encoder-decoder model on the CNN/DailyMail summarization dataset with Seq2SeqTrainer
test_return_sequences: test that Seq2SeqTrainer returns the correct number of generated sequences when num_return_sequences is greater than 1
test_bad_generation_config_fail_early: test that Seq2SeqTrainer raises a ValueError when given an incompatible generation config like top_p with do_sample disabled
test_run_seq2seq_no_dist: test running the seq2seq translation example script in non-distributed mode and verify BLEU metrics are logged
test_run_seq2seq_ddp: test running the seq2seq translation example script in distributed DDP mode and verify BLEU metrics are logged
